hand_contract_diagnosis_v1/analysis.json.meaning: Forecast errors use identical predictions and commands; changing only physical execution separates the new hand contract from existing prediction error. Negative forecast-error change means moving-wrist execution is closer to the old forecast.
hand_contract_diagnosis_v1/analysis.json.direction_definition: Cosine between predicted and observed command-induced movement, scaled by 1.8 cm and 11 degrees: +1 same direction, 0 perpendicular, -1 opposite. Zero movement pairs are excluded.

hand_response_fit_v1/result.json.method: 44 separate ridge regressions predict 250 ms joint movement from the requested angle error and initial angular velocity, with an intercept. Inputs/output use each native joint range. Coefficients are fit on unique commands in bodies 0–3 only; native joint/tendon projection follows prediction.

hand_response_choice_v1/result.json.learner: Private 44-joint response fit, not installed UEMA weights.

hand_response_choice_v1/physical_units.j.method: Mean finger terminal-segment origin distance and orientation angle in its actual wrist frame, relative to the same-state physical witness; eight held-out trials.

hand_projection_gradient_full.json.reference: The same private objective and neutral constrained SLSQP solve, using finite-difference derivatives as the pre-repair runtime did.
hand_projection_gradient_full.json.gradient_cases: Four feasible coupled nonzero poses and residuals just below positive/negative pi, both hands; quaternion sign equivalence.
